latestVersion.changelog:
Archery Range Video skill — initial release:

- Provides video assistance for archery ranges, bow shops, and clubs.
- Focuses on beginner recruitment and community-building videos.
- Covers topics from first-time safety briefings to equipment fitting and student progression.
- Helps demystify the range experience for newcomers and highlight coaching culture.
- Designed to boost attendance at beginner classes and league nights through engaging video content.
